definitions.explanation: A licensed healthcare professional who provides medical care and support to patients in hospitals, clinics, and other healthcare settings.

examples.japanese: {看護師|かんごし}⟦さん→さん：09848_san⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
{看護師|かんごし}⟦さん→さん：09848_san⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{血圧|けつあつ}→血圧：00218_ketsuatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}ってくれる→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: The nurse measures my blood pressure every day.

examples.japanese: {看護師|かんごし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国家試験|こっかしけん}→国家試験：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}しなければならない→合格する：02816_goukaku⟧。
examples.english: To become a nurse, you must pass the national exam.

notes:
{看護師|かんごし} is the modern, gender-neutral term for nurse that replaced the older terms ⟦{看護婦|かんごふ}→看護婦：01380_kangofu⟧ (female nurse) and ⟦{看護士|かんごし}→看護士：noentry⟧ (male nurse) in 2002.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {看護師|かんごし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become a nurse)
- {看護師|かんごし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work as a nurse)
- {看護師|かんごし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧ (to aim to become a nurse)
- ⟦{正看護師|せいかんごし}→正看護師：noentry⟧ (registered nurse)
- ⟦{准看護師|じゅんかんごし}→准看護師：27717_junkangoshi⟧ (practical nurse)

USAGE:
- Often addressed or referred to as {看護師|かんごし}⟦さん→さん：09848_san⟧ when speaking to or about a nurse respectfully.
